criteria.requirement: Fix draft-2019-09 find_evaluated_item_indexes_by_schema so boolean single-schema items is never treated as a tuple and len(bool) never occurs under unevaluatedItems. items=true evaluates all array positions; items=false must still yield standard validation failure for nonempty arrays and accept empty arrays without TypeError. Preserve tuple/additionalItems behavior, successful combinator annotations, nonarray handling and independent draft-2020-12 prefixItems semantics. Use actual Draft201909Validator paths, not special-case input data or disable unevaluatedItems.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
